files.purpose: PiSession is the ProviderSession that drives the Pi coding harness as one long-lived `pi --mode rpc` child per thread, speaking LF-delimited JSONL over stdin/stdout: it launches pi with `--mode rpc -e <extension> --approve|--no-approve [--provider/--model] [--thinking] [--session <file>]`, performs the get_state then get_commands handshake, sends prompt/set_model/set_thinking_level/abort/compact lines, and turns message_start/message_update/message_end/tool_execution_*/agent_end/compaction_*/auto_retry_start/extension_error/extension_ui_request lines into ProviderEvents. It also owns Droppy's own approval gate for Pi: it writes a per-session JSON gate file (runtimeMode, interactionMode, finalReport, systemPrompt "") that the installed pi extension reads before each tool call, answers the extension's `droppy-gate ` select requests with "Allow" / "Allow for session" / "Deny" (remembering session grants by kind), and maps confirm/input/editor/select/notify extension UI requests to questions and notices. At B3 its stream-id bookkeeping, write snapshots, request continuations, tool-text extraction and grant keys are delegated to shared helpers (StreamedTextTracker, EditSnapshots, PendingReplies, ToolText, ApprovalRequest.Kind.grantKey) and its close path now releases every pending request with JSON null.

feature_notes: B2->B3 churn 106 lines (654 -> 610 lines), all from upstream commit d70cff8fe 'refactor: audit cleanups — five bug fixes, shared MCP and provider code, layer rules restored'.

Refactor, no observable change: the seven stream fields (launchID initializer, messageCounter, thinkingCounter, currentMessageID, currentThinkingID, messageText, thinkingText) are replaced by `launchID: String` assigned in init plus `stream: StreamedTextTracker`. Checked against SessionSupport.swift: startMessage()+resetThinking() equals B2's message_start (counter+1, new id, messageText "", thinkingText "", currentThinkingID nil); appendMessage keeps the buffer when minting a lazy id, as B2 did; appendThinking with default resetsText true empties thinkingText when minting, as B2 did; endThinking/endMessage only nil the ids, as B2 did. Id shapes stay "<launchID>-m-<n>" and "<launchID>-t-<n>".

Refactor, no observable change: editSnapshots is now EditSnapshots; capture(id, path:) stores read(path) ?? "" with the same fileSize <= 1_000_000 and UTF-8 rule as B2's removed snapshot(_:); editDiff's write branch uses text(id) then discard(id), equal to B2's removeValue(forKey:) ?? "".

Refactor, no observable change: B2's private static text(in:) is replaced by ToolText.blocks (ProviderSession.swift:213-218), same null/string/array handling and "\n" join; B2's private static grantKey(_:) is replaced by ApprovalRequest.Kind.grantKey (ProviderSession.swift:223-229) with the identical mapping command->"command", fileChange->"fileChange", tool/permissions/plan->"tool".

Behaviour change: request(_:) now uses PendingReplies.register(id, timeout: .seconds(30), timeoutValue: .null) and returns `value ?? .null`. The 30 second JSON-null timeout and the droppy-<n> numbering are unchanged, but register first calls Task.checkCancellation() (a cancelled caller gets .null WITHOUT the request line being written, while requestCounter has already advanced) and installs a cancellation handler (a caller cancelled while waiting resumes at once with .null). B2's withCheckedContinuation ignored cancellation, so the 30 second timer was the only bound.

Behaviour change (bug fix): didClose(status:) now begins with pendingResponses.resolveAll(.null) (:594), before the stderr tail is taken. A get_state/get_commands (or post-set_model get_state) still pending when pi exits now resolves immediately with JSON null instead of waiting out the 30 second timer; e.g. a pi that dies during the handshake now lets start() finish (empty id, .sessionReady) right after .exited instead of 30 seconds later.

The response case at :288-294 is rewritten as `if !pendingResponses.resolve(id, message), command == "prompt", success == false` - same semantics as B2's removeValue/else-if (resolve returns false only when no continuation was waiting).
unresolved_questions: UNRESOLVED: whether any B3 caller ever cancels the Task running PiSession.start() or send() (ThreadRuntime.swift :1514, :1522, :1583, :1599 call `try await candidate.start()`); if none does, the new cancellation path in request(_:) is unreachable in practice and only the didClose resolveAll change is observable.
